verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a public REST API. It has an API reference with key generation, a quickstart that places a call and fetches the transcript, documented endpoints such as POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories and agent create/update fields, and workflows 'driven entirely through the Bolna API'. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path, which means no machine-readable spec was found; it does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Make your first Voice AI call with the Bolna API — verify your key, get an agent, place a call, and fetch the transcript in about five minutes.
